submission.justification: Recommend Mixture-G2 with a 1 mm gas gap as the best defensible choice from the recorded evidence. G2 is one of the allowed candidates, has the lowest verified GWP100 (15, well below the 150 limit), has no recorded operational conflicts, is nonflammable, supplier-available, compatible with the 12 kV HV system, and supported by the gas recirculation system. A 1 mm gap is within the allowed 1–3 mm range and is selected to favor timing performance, but the recorded search found no usable simulation or document time-resolution values; therefore the 1.5 ns hard timing requirement cannot be verified from the available results.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: No time-resolution source documents were found; extracted_time_resolution_points=0 and all candidate/gap resolution values are recorded as -1. A 1 mm gap was chosen to favor timing, but no simulation evidence confirms it is optimal.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 is one of the three allowed candidates; allowed_candidate_count=3.

requirements.requirement: The time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better.
requirements.evidence: selected_time_resolution_ns=-1; documents_checked_for_time_resolution=6; time_resolution_source_documents_found=0. The requirement cannot be verified from the recorded results.

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150.
requirements.evidence: G2_GWP100_verified=15, giving a margin of 135 below the policy maximum of 150.
Recommended gap is 1 mm, which lies within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended mixture and gas gap.
requirements.evidence: Submitted Mixture-G2 with a 1 mm gas gap.
